links.outcome: Hallucinations in AI-generated histories of present illness, as reviewed by pediatric emergency physicians
links.effect: Physician reviewers noted no hallucinations in the final transcripts, though summaries sometimes lacked important features of prior visits.
links.quote: They noted no hallucinations in the final transcripts.

screen.reason: Prospective feasibility pilot evaluating patient/caregiver use of a HIPAA-compliant ChatGPT-4 instance to gather medical histories in an emergency department waiting room alongside physician evaluation of the outputs.
